|game_text=Deploy on table. You may initiate battles for free. During a battle you initiate, each time opponent plays an interrupt, opponent must first use 1 Force. |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008)
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Effect: Battle Plan & •Draw Their Fire, Coruscant, R
|strategy=By I-Ming Chen<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/battleplananddrawtheirfire.html</ref>

Wow! This combo effect packs the full punch of [[Battle Plan]] while only removing the risky retrieval from [[Draw Their Fire]]. This is card efficiency at its finest. Starting it, you can limit your opponent's ability to play multiple interrupts early game due to low activation and late game due to lack of Force. Best of all, this [[Draw Their Fire]] can't come out and cost you the game. The only drawback is the fact that it cannot be pulled with [[Your Insight Serves You Well]].
